mcq_fix.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with its stage of demographic transition?
Which of the following correctly describes India's recent demographic profile (SRS 2024)?

Consider the following statements: 1. Kerala and Tamil Nadu are among the most aged States of India. 2. About 18.7% of elderly women live alone. 3. About 78% of elderly persons have no pension cover. 4. About 70% of elderly persons depend on others. Which of the statements given above are correct?

pyq_bad.why: garbled; another question's text in options
wrong topic: state schemes current affairs

patterns: Definition questions dominate: 'rise in growth due to rising share of working age' = demographic dividend; the age group is keyed 15-59 (APPSC-G2) or 15-64 (UPSC/ILO), so never put both in the options.
Transition stages are asked as sequences (high-high, then high-low, then low-low) and as 'population explosion = 1951-81'.
Thinker-idea lines: Malthus geometric/arithmetic; elderly QoL index ranking (Rajasthan).
UPSC-style 'what should India do' (skill development) items appear; the app adds many 2026 SRS/NFHS-6 numeric statement sets not seen in PYQs.
